name: The Drone Eternal
classification: Class VI Sustained Temporal Deceleration Field

detectability.signature: Uniform temporal gradient producing a measurable redshift in all emissions from within the field, coupled with a monotone gravitational wave at 0.003 Hz detectable at extreme range

proximity: Clocks begin losing synchronization with external references at a rate proportional to distance from the field center
Communications with vessels inside the field experience progressive time-stretching, voices dropping in pitch until unintelligible
Sensor returns from objects within the field arrive with increasing latency unrelated to light-speed delay
contact: Time dilation reaches a factor of approximately 200:1 at the field boundary, with exponential increase toward the center
All shipboard processes slow proportionally; crew are unaware of deceleration but lose hours to days of external time per minute of subjective experience
Electromagnetic systems experience frequency collapse as photon wavelengths stretch in the dilated frame
prolonged_exposure: Return to normal spacetime after extended immersion causes severe chronological shock as the body attempts to reconcile subjective and objective time
Accumulated time debt becomes irrecoverable; crews have returned to find decades or centuries have passed
At extreme depth, the dilation factor exceeds measurable thresholds and objects effectively freeze in time permanently

phenomena: Objects that entered the field billions of years ago remain visible near the center, frozen in states of partial decay that have not progressed measurably in recorded history
Light emitted from the field's interior is redshifted into a narrow band, giving the entire sphere a deep, uniform crimson glow
The boundary region produces a visible 'horizon' where light from behind the field bends and smears into concentric arcs
A monotone gravitational wave emanates from the center, so low in frequency that it takes hours to complete a single cycle
hazards: Any vessel entering the field will experience time dilation severe enough to strand the crew in the future relative to their point of origin
The temporal gradient at the boundary is steep enough to create destructive tidal forces on elongated objects as bow and stern experience different time rates
Rescue operations are functionally impossible, as any rescue vessel entering the field becomes equally trapped in dilated time
opportunities: The field's predictable and uniform gradient makes it an ideal natural laboratory for studying temporal physics at scales impossible to replicate artificially
Objects preserved near the center include debris from the earliest epochs of stellar formation, offering a window into primordial astrophysics
Theoretical work suggests that a sufficiently advanced drive system could use the temporal gradient as an energy source, though no practical extraction method exists
known_incidents: The exploration frigate Sustained Note entered the Drone Eternal in 3214 CE on a mapping mission with an estimated two-hour subjective duration. The crew emerged 847 years later in 4061 CE, believing they had been inside for ninety minutes. Their sensor data remains the most detailed survey of the field's interior ever collected.

An automated probe launched into the deep interior in 3590 CE has been continuously observed for over four centuries. From the external frame, the probe has traveled approximately eleven meters since launch and shows no signs of malfunction.
description: The Drone Eternal is a perfect sphere of dilated spacetime 12,500 kilometers in radius, within which time passes at a fraction of its normal rate. From the outside, it appears as a deep crimson orb, its color the product of extreme redshifting of all light emitted from within. The surface is featureless and uniform, giving the impression of a vast, still eye staring into the surrounding void. The gravitational wave it produces is so low in frequency that instruments must observe for hours to confirm a single oscillation, a drone beneath the threshold of any meaningful detection except by the most sensitive equipment.

The dilation effect follows a smooth exponential curve from the boundary inward, reaching a factor of roughly 200:1 at the edge and climbing toward infinity at the center. Objects crossing the boundary experience the gradient as an invisible wall of temporal viscosity, their processes slowing without any subjective awareness of change. From the outside, a ship entering the field appears to decelerate, redden, and eventually freeze in place, its running lights dimming to infrared over the course of hours. The effect is entirely reversible upon exit, but the time lost to the external universe is not.

The Drone Eternal is among the oldest known anomalies, estimated at 4.1 billion years based on the composition of debris visible near its center, which includes protostellar material and mineral formations consistent with the earliest epoch of the local stellar neighborhood. Its origin is believed to be a natural consequence of an extreme mass-energy event during galactic formation, possibly the collapse of a hypermassive object that imprinted a permanent temporal scar on the surrounding spacetime. It was discovered in 2987 CE by a long-range survey that detected its characteristic monotone gravitational emission.

The Drone Eternal is currently surrounded by a network of warning buoys and observation platforms maintained by the Temporal Hazards Commission. It is one of the most heavily restricted anomalies in charted space, with unauthorized approach carrying severe legal penalties in most jurisdictions. Despite this, it exerts a persistent fascination on researchers, philosophers, and the occasionally desperate. The frozen shapes visible deep within its crimson interior are a subject of endless speculation, and at least one major religious movement regards the Drone as a place where eternity can be touched. The Commission's position remains firm: what enters the Drone does not return to the same universe it left.
